data.extraction: Column means of the binary matrix; genuine rewards are sampled as Bernoulli(p).

protocol.clock: Each genuine or injected sample consumes one of T records, including initialization.
protocol.cost: Sum of abs(fake_reward - true_arm_mean), for every processed fake record.
protocol.ucb_rewards: Bernoulli draws at the selected MovieLens column mean.
protocol.randomness: SplitMix64 and Box-Muller; arm-wise reward streams and posterior streams are paired across methods.
protocol.pbi: Reject nonpositive signed gaps or cooldowns below one; record infeasible arms without excluding trials. Recertify delayed batches before execution.
protocol.heuristic: Randomly place SBI's realized per-arm fake budget after initialization; exactly match counts and true-mean cost.
protocol.li: Unbounded reference; not subject to the bounded methods' reward interval.

ucb-cost-delta.interpolation: Straight segments between recorded points; no extrapolation.
ucb-cost-delta.markers: Recorded sweep points or recorded trajectory checkpoints.
ucb-cost-delta.error_band: mean plus/minus one sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
